needed.evidence: No continuous paved sidewalk; only an uneven dirt/gravel strip beside the carriageway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous paved footway on the left side to give pedestrians a safe, level route away from the road.

needed.evidence: No proper sidewalk; an informal dirt strip runs along the roadside with parked vehicles encroaching on it.
needed.suggestion: Provide a continuous paved footway on the right side, set back from parked vehicles, to create a safe pedestrian route.

needed.evidence: The left roadside strip is uneven with ruts and loose material that would trip a pedestrian.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the left-side footway to remove ruts and uneven sections that create trip hazards.

needed.evidence: The right-side informal path is uneven and partly obstructed, with rough ground that poses trip risks.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the right-side footway, clearing debris, to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Commercial buildings and a parked car on the right create crossing demand, but no marked or signalised crossing is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked pedestrian crossing with good visibility to provide a safe place to cross this commercial street.
